results.title: Muncy's tiebreaking RBI lifts A's to 1st series win since mid-June, beat Sox 4-3
results.description: Max Muncy hit a tiebreaking RBI double off the Green Monster against closer Aroldis Chapman in the ninth inning and the Athletics rallied past the Boston Red Sox 4-3 for their first series win after losing 12 straight.

results.title: Jannik Sinner withdraws from Cincinnati Open because of knee injury
results.description: CINCINNATI (AP) — Jannik Sinner, the world's No. 1 men's tennis player, withdrew from the Cincinnati Open on Sunday because of a knee injury.

results.title: Paddlers take Lake Champlain for 20th Annual Dragonboat race
results.description: More than 50 teams of paddlers took to Lake Champlain Dragonboat festival. Since it first began, the event has raised more than $3.7 million dollars, all donated to nonprofits supporting cancer patients.
